title: Sr Technology FP&A Manager - Cloud Hosting
searchText: Sr Technology FP&A Manager - Cloud Hosting Reddit Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 121 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Role Overview Reddit is seeking a strong, hands on, analytical and strategic Senior Finance Manager to join our Technology FP&A team , with a primary focus on Cloud Hosting spend . This role will provide Finance and Technology leadership with complete visibility into hosting costs and ensure a clear understanding of the drivers of change. The Finance Manager will integrate hosting spend into Reddit's budget and forecasts, reconcile actuals during the close, and partner with Engineering to track and validate cost-saving initiatives. Key Responsibilities Forecasting & Budgeting Develop sophisticated financial models for hosting spend, long-term financial planning, and strategic contract negotiations Conduct scenario analysis for scaling, product launches, and contract commitments Lead monthly variance analysis of spend vs. the budget and forecast for different LoBs Build standardized and consistent reporting packages highlighting trends and their impact on Reddit’s P&L Develop cost optimization initiatives and tracking mechanisms Develop ROI models to support cloud investments in the areas of strategic importance Cost Optimization & Governance Leverage previous experiences and industry best practices to proactively propose efficiency initiatives to engineering Drive savings initiatives to completion by developing accountability mechanisms for engineering Enforce tagging and allocation governance for improved visibility and accountability Serve as a financial advisor to engineering, SRE, and cloud platform teams, providing insights on budgeting, unit economics, optimizations and financial strategy. Analytics & Tools Build and maintain dashboards to serve as Finance’s source of truth for hosting cost reporting. Use billing tools to support reporting accuracy. Stay up-to-date on industry trends and regulations related to cloud technology and incorporate findings into financial strategies Cost of Revenue (COR) Ownership Complete ownership of the COR forecast. Own and maintain the weekly COR file, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely updates Provide clear weekly visibility into changes in hosting costs, explaining drivers of variance to Finance and Technology leadership. Partner with Accounting during close to reconcile COR actuals with invoices and financial records. Qualifications 8+ years of experience in FP&A, Technology Finance, or Cost of Revenue management . Prior experience includes AWS and GCP contract negotiations. Proven experience owning and maintaining Cost of Revenue or Hosting budget files (weekly/monthly) and explaining drivers of change to leadership. Hands-on experience with AWS and GCP billing tools (Cost Explorer, CUR, Budgets). Proficiency with dashboard building, data modeling, financial reporting. Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis skills with proven accuracy in managing Hosting budget vs. actuals. Demonstrated ability to track and report hosting cost savings from optimization initiatives and commitment programs. Excellent cross-functional communication skills to partner with Finance, Engineering, and Accounting. Strongly prefer background in professional services (consulting, Big 4, or advisory) with exposure to structured financial processes or cost governance. Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $167,500 — $234,500 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors .
